fields.climate: varies with terrain, from tropical along coast to semiarid and hot in north
fields.terrain: diverse, with coastal plain in southwest, dissected plateau in center, mountains in west, plains in north
fields.hazards: volcanic activity with periodic releases of poisonous gases from Lake Nyos and Lake Monoun volcanoes; volcanism: Mt. Cameroon (4,095 m), which last erupted in 2000, is the most frequently active volcano in West Africa…
fields.resources: petroleum, bauxite, iron ore, timber, hydropower
fields.farm: cassava, plantains, oil palm fruit, maize, taro, tomatoes, sorghum, sugarcane, bananas, vegetables
fields.exports: crude petroleum, natural gas, gold, cocoa beans, wood
fields.industries: petroleum production and refining, aluminum production, food processing, light consumer goods, textiles, lumber, ship repair
fields.languages: 24 major African language groups, English (official), French (official)
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 33.1%, Muslim 30.6%, Protestant 27.1% other Christian 6.1%, animist 1.3%, other 0.7%, none 1.2%
fields.legal: mixed system of English common law, French civil law, and customary law
fields.military: 18-23 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women (18-28 for medical services); no conscription; service obligation 4 years
